belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that large size spaces virtual may influence diameter mean pupil scene. The evidence base (4 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Neurological Mechanisms, Psychophysics / Perception). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of large size spaces virtual, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of large size spaces virtual on diameter mean pupil scene replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains large size spaces virtual → diameter mean pupil scene?
research_needs.rationale: 2 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for large size spaces virtual effects on diameter mean pupil scene?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
